ordering.source: WiLLstudio Ordering Matrix & Part Numbers (Tyler, 2026-08-03) — decoded from the WiLLstudio decorative-arms ordering sheet
ordering.provenance: Transcribed from the ordering-matrix reference note (the arms sheet Tyler supplied on 2026-08-03) — the ONLY hand-transcribed ordering data in the repo. Fixture + decorative-pole numbers are built from the machine-parsed spec sheets instead (docs/spec-options.json). Parts with neither source resolve to no part number rather than a fabricated one.
ordering.socketOdNote: Nominal OD (inches) of the host socket an arm slips over — drives the Pole/Tenon Fit segment. Sockets absent from this map (nafco-tenon, sport-pole-top, pendant, arm-mount) have no published fit vocabulary, so the fit segment stays unresolved instead of guessed.
ordering.fitToleranceNote: A derived OD must land within this many inches of a code's nominal OD, else the fit segment stays unresolved. 'hostPoleShaftOd' reads the host pole's shaft OD from its placeholder radiusTopM (the shaft above the decorative base flare), so a 4" nominal shaft resolves to the 4" fit code.
